'''Dan Christy Lower End Of Tustin (tournament report)''' is [[Dan Christy]]'s report on [[Tustin tournament (The Outer Rim)]], published on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]] as Mystikal.<ref name="or-tustin2">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Tustinreport2.htm Lower End Of Tustin], The Outer Rim (Mystikal). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261029234719/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Tustinreport2.htm Internet Archive]</ref> He finished 6 (−8) over eight games with [[Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself|Rescue The Princess]] and Skrillings.

== Original report ==

<blockquote>
<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:inherit"><nowiki>
Title: Lower End Of Tustin

 Some of you may have read Mr. Guzman's
 report on Tustin, But I will report on the lower non-winning end of the scene.
 BUT first of all the kid Tim so inaccurately called "DONKEY" was actually called
 "Donkey-boy" . I was playing Rescue The Princess for light, and Skrillings for
 dark.

 GAME 1:

 Rescue The Princess vs. Brad's Space deck.

 I lost end of story. Gory details will not be written.

 0(-14)

 Game 2:

 Skrillings vs. Hidden Base

 I played against one of the most frustrating decks ever. I had 6 sites out and
 a drain of 0. I lost this game as well. He had It's A Hit, It Could Be Worse,
 and Rebel Fleet In addition to the cancellations that Hidden Base Provided.
 I lost by 26.

 0(-30)

 Game 3:

 Rescue The Princess vs. Mains and Toys

 This is the most humiliating win of my life. My opponent was a newcomer to the
 game, so everything went off without any difficulty. I felt bad destroying this
 guy. I won by 12.

 2(-18)

 Game 4:

 Skrillings vs. Mains 'n' Toys

 This was the most fun game that I had played all day. My opponent was very classy
 and polite. I kept most of his mains out of Jabba's Palace by using Scanning
 Crew and with No Bargain. When he finally did deploy EPP Leia against Bossk
 and a skrilling, he drew a destiny of 0. But then he went to space and slowly
 drained me to death. I lost by 4. It was an honorable loss to a good opponent
 though.

 2(-22)

 Game 5:

 Skrillings vs. Dagobah Clouds/Death Star Plans

 This was great. I saw his starting location, Dagobah, so I used Come Here, You
 Big Coward! as my starting effect. His only characters that had any chance of
 stopping this effect were gas miners and A Han Solo. His deck was rendered TOTALLY
 useless. I won by 36.

 4(+14)

 Game 6:

 Rescue The Princess vs. Carbon Chamber Testing w/Skrillings

 Well this hurts. 2 captives right from the start. I got hit hard in few battles,
 and there was no way to recover. I lost by 24.

 4(-10)

 Lunch:

 I, unlike Tim, had a grip of food. It was the high point of the day.

 Game 7:

 Rescue The Princess vs. Nal Hutta Operatives.

 Not a promising start. He flipped his objective on turn 2 and I still had no
 characters in hand. Finally got my objective flipped, but lost a crucial battle
 on Nal Hutta. I couldn't recover at all. Loss of 26.

 4(-36)

 Game 8:

 Skrillings vs. Hidden Base

 I drew a lot of sites right off, and I knew I would have to be quick or he'd
 be able to cancel all my drains. I had the Cantina, Judland Wastes with Expand
 The Empire, Jabba's Palace, Audience Chamber, and Rancor Pit. He took forever
 to flip his objective. By the time he did, I already had the game won. Then
 I used Abyssin Ornament for 12, and I won by 28.

 6(-8)

 And that's how Tustin Turned out for me. BUT I did get a lightside Death Star
 and a Rouge 1 in my consolation packs. Anyways, I didn't do that well, but the
 comedy we recieved from Donkey-boy the whole time made it worth the effort.
 But do take notice, my last game was a win and I plan on carrying it over to
 Vegas. START

 Mystikal
</nowiki></div>
</blockquote>
